## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0366b4766e7a4d3c104c6ad63524475ba899755f`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #12187 (body and all three comments: triage `6118609734`, claim `6119197321`, os-dev-report `6119911156`), PR #12203 (body, 19-file list, net diff against `main` `26b0bd2` at the head), the head's check-runs (read twice, the second reading immediately before this record was written), the lane precedent (objectui#12146 claim `6115255402`, record `6115689810`), plus head-pinned reads of the files the diff touches or calls: `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`, `i18n.ts`, `provider.tsx`, `locales/registry.ts`, `useSafeTranslation.ts`, `packages/components/src/custom/spinner.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, `chrome/RedirectWithSplash.tsx`, `chrome/ConditionalAuthWrapper.tsx`, `apps/console/src/main.tsx`, `apps/console/index.html`, `packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts`, `scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` (header), `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`, `packages/i18n/README.md`, `.changeset/config.json`, the workflow files `ci.yml`, `lint.yml`, `changeset-guard.yml`, `changeset-presence.yml` and `performance-budget.yml`, and `LoadingScreen.tsx` at the base. One read outside this repository, named under R1 in ③: objectstack `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` and `.objectui-sha` at objectstack `main` `a2240c4d`. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`@object-ui/i18n` accept set narrows — RIGHT, and declared.** Four leaf keys leave all ten packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh) in one change: `console.loadingSteps.connecting`, `console.loadingSteps.loadingConfig`, `console.loadingSteps.preparingWorkspace`, `console.loadingHint`. Compared hunk by hunk across the ten packs: the same `loadingSteps` block and the same `loadingHint` row leave each one (en and zh carry `loadingHint` after the block, the other eight after `initializing`; all ten drop it). `TranslationKeys` is `typeof en`, `en` is declared `as const`, and both are exported from `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`, so the published key union loses `console.loadingSteps` and `console.loadingHint`, and the literal type of `console.initializing` moves. No alias, no second spelling, no deprecated carrier: the retired names leave at once, as the startup-stage rule requires. The changeset names all four and the value move (② below).
2. **`console.initializing` is a new VALUE, no new key — RIGHT.** The claim left the dev to measure value-versus-key from the key's other readers; `RedirectWithSplash` renders the same `LoadingScreen` (read at the head), so a new key would have split one boot face into two spellings. Every pack carries the new line; every new value ends in the ellipsis glyph the `ellipsis-glyph-3878` pin requires (`console.initializing` is on its list); the ar value keeps the converged `جارٍ` (U+064D) spelling the `6610` pin holds. en "Opening your console…" and zh 「正在打开你的控制台…」 are the card's own words.
3. **`@object-ui/app-shell` public surface: `LoadingScreen` keeps its export and its props — RIGHT.** `LoadingScreen` and `RedirectWithSplash` are exported from the package index; `LoadingScreenProps` (`message`, `error`, `onRetry`, `retrying`) is the same at base and head. The error block and the `message` branch are unchanged. What moves is behaviour, and it is the ruling's: the three-step list, its 1200 ms `setInterval` and the hint paragraph are gone; a `Spinner` stands where the list stood; the status line's paragraph is reserved at `min-h-5` so its arrival does not shift the layout.
4. **H1, the steps were cosmetic — RIGHT.** At the base, `currentStep` is component state advanced only by the timer, and the step list is read only in render. Nothing else imports or reads either. Removing them changes no contract.
5. **H2, the English came from the html element's `lang` attribute — RIGHT, and the fix reads the right source.** At the base `getStartupStrings()` read `document.documentElement.lang` first; `apps/console/index.html` ships that attribute as `en`; `I18nProvider` writes it in a passive `useEffect` after its children's first render (provider.tsx, the `languageChanged` effect). The head reads `useObjectTranslation().language`, which is `context.language`: provider state initialised from `i18nInstance.language` on the provider's first render. So the first commit sees the resolved language, and the new pin's layout-effect probe asserts the ordering (attribute still `en`, text already zh) rather than a later frame.
6. **"No English before the locale" — RIGHT, with the choice named.** The line is read as a plain property off the RESIDENT catalogue for the active language (`getLoadedBuiltInLocales()`, exact tag then base, the registry's own order), never through `t()`, whose `fallbackLng: 'en'` would answer a pack still in flight with English. While the catalogue is not resident the line is `null`: product name and spinner only. The card's fix direction said "a neutral string"; the dev's neutral string is the empty line, language-neutral by construction, and the acceptance text ("is not English") is met. When the catalogue lands, the provider's `addResourceBundle` write re-renders the screen because `useObjectTranslation` passes `bindI18nStore: 'added'` (`STORE_WRITES_RERENDER`), and the registry holds the catalogue resident before that write. The console awaits `preloadBootstrapLocale({ hasLoader: true })` before `createRoot().render()` (`main.tsx`), so there the line is present from the first paint, which is what the dev's Chromium reading shows.
7. **The error block still degrades to `en` field by field — RIGHT.** An error must say something, and a pack behind on a `console.*` key must render English there rather than `undefined` (objectui#2872 part (a)). This is the one place `en` remains the splash's fallback, and the changeset says so.
8. **Pre-JS splash untouched — RIGHT.** `#boot-splash` in `apps/console/index.html` is markup only ("NO TEXT, deliberately", in its own comment), so the claim's "only if it carries boot copy" condition is not met and the file is correctly left alone.
9. **Items 2 and 3 untouched — RIGHT.** The 19-file list holds no chunk, `manualChunks`, icon-registry, inspector-registry or `sys_user_preference` change.
10. **Pins hold what remains — RIGHT.** `ar-participle-orthography-6610`: the converged list keeps five rows, `console.initializing` at its new value, the three step rows gone with their keys; the pack-wide rule is unchanged. `dead-key-batch-retired-4730`: the LoadingScreen blind-spot list keeps the five keys the screen still reads by property access (`error.connectionFailed`, `error.checkServer`, `initializing`, `actions.retry`, `actions.retrying`). `RedirectWithSplash.test.tsx` asserts the new line and no step. The new `LoadingScreen.bootCopy-12187.test.tsx` holds the five things the ruling asks for: zh on the first commit before the attribute is written, the en control, one line with nothing moving over 10 s of fake time, no line while the pack is not resident and the line once it lands (the residency case built by hiding one code from the snapshot and nothing else), and the error block in the provider language.
11. **Changeset body against the diff — RIGHT.** Every sentence is borne out: the one line and the spinner; the 1200 ms timer and the "new environment" line gone; the error and retry block unchanged; language from `useObjectTranslation().language` instead of the attribute, with the attribute-timing mechanism stated correctly; the line left out rather than English while not resident; the four keys named with "no replacement"; `console.initializing` keeps its key, FROM "Initializing application…" TO "Opening your console…"; the one-line fix ("drop them: nothing reads them any more").
12. **Two nits, not defects.** (a) `getStartupStrings` re-spells exact-then-base inline; the registry's `matchLanguageTag` is that order's one implementation inside `@object-ui/i18n` but is not exported from the entry, so app-shell cannot call it. The order matches. (b) The `packages/i18n/src/index.ts` comment still calls `en` "the synchronous dictionary the app-shell splash renders from before i18n is usable", the same sentence the dev flagged in the README; `en` remains the error block's fallback and the `TranslationKeys` source, so the residency argument stands and only that phrasing is stale.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/12187-boot-screen-copy.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`, `@object-ui/i18n: minor`. The i18n accept set narrows (① item 1), so the change is breaking and the changeset carries its migration: each retired key mapped FROM its name TO "no replacement", the `console.initializing` value mapped FROM the old line TO the new, and the one-line fix. Both packages sit in the one fixed group of `.changeset/config.json`, so they move together regardless. The level is `minor`, which is the floor for `Clause-②: yes` and, under this repository's rule that its own breaking changes are declared `minor` with the breaking semantics in the body (⛔ never `major`), also the ceiling. **Level RIGHT.** The precedent (objectui#12146, a widening at `minor`) reads the same way for a narrowing.
- **`Clause-②: yes`** — declared on the claim `6119197321` with its reason, and at the start of a line in the PR body; the diff bears it out (`TranslationKeys` narrows). The line carries no arm; the rule allows at most one, so the bare form is well-formed. The accurate arm would be `(narrowing)`, and the changeset body says **Breaking** in its own words, which is what that arm signals; the level does not move either way. **Line RIGHT**; the absent arm is noted for the seat's amendment if it keeps arms on this card's later items.
- Changeset family on this head: Changeset Bump Policy (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`), Changeset Declaration (`check-changeset-presence.mjs`), Changeset Claim Re-read (`check-changeset-claims.mjs`), Changeset Overwrite Report, Changeset Fixed Group Check — all `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (os-dev-report `6119911156`, `deviations`):

- **D1 — file outside the claim's surface, `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`: ANSWERED, accepted.** Read at the head. Its control group builds `console.loadingSteps.*` from segments (`key('loadingSteps', 'connecting')`) on purpose, so that neither the dotted key nor its property chain occurs contiguously in the file; that is why the claim's grep could not list it. Its POSITIVE control asserts that `textFootprint` names `LoadingScreen.tsx (via property chain)` for every key in `READ_BY_PROPERTY_ACCESS`; once the screen stops reading the three step keys that assertion fails honestly, and once the keys leave `en` the sweep has nothing to probe. The edit drops the three rows, keeps the four the file still reads that way, and leaves the NEGATIVE control (`console.error.serverUnreachable`, `console.error.timeout`) untouched. Not stopping was right: a pin of the old behaviour cannot survive the ruling, the same treatment the claim itself prescribed for the two listed i18n pins. The seat records the surface addition.
- **D2 — the empty-language branch (`language ? … : undefined`): ANSWERED, accepted, with a follow-up named.** The real hook never yields an empty language (`context?.language || i18n.language || 'en'`), so the branch is unreachable in production; under an empty language it yields no line, which is the conservative direction (not English), not a lenient fallback to off-spec input. It is load-bearing only for ten boot-path test doubles whose `useObjectTranslation` returns no `language` (the dev's ablation (c): 53 tests throw without it). Widening those doubles to `language: 'en'` is outside this surface; the seat decides whether it earns a carrier, after which the branch can go.
- **D3 — `useObjectTranslation()` in a screen whose old note said not to: ANSWERED, accepted, on the dev's ground, which is verified.** `createI18n` sets `react: { useSuspense: false }` with a comment naming exactly the bootstrap suspension the old note feared (`i18n.ts`, read at the head), so under a provider built by `createI18n` the hook does not suspend. Outside any provider it does not throw: it reports `'en'` or the global instance's language (`useI18nContext` is the hook that throws, and the screen does not call it). The `Spinner` the screen already rendered at the base in its `message` branch goes through `createSafeTranslation`, which calls `useObjectTranslation` (`useSafeTranslation.ts`), so the hook was already on this screen's render path before this change. Scope, stated: a host that passes its own `instance` owns its `useSuspense` setting for the whole shell, this screen included, exactly as before for every other renderer. `ConditionalAuthWrapper.tsx` carries the same stale premise in its own note and keeps its literal strings; untouched, correctly. The objectui#7479 rule stands: no pack is imported back in, and `Bundle Analysis` (the job that runs `check-eager-locale-catalogues.mjs`) is `success` on this head.
- **D4 — model-free commit trailers and the session-URL body footer: ANSWERED, accepted.** objectui AGENTS.md prescribes that pair and that footer form; the harness reminder yields to them. Commit messages are not an input to this record; the body footer is present in the form the surface keeps.
- **D5 — relay strokes transported as objectstack repository dispatches: ANSWERED, immaterial to the contract.** A fleet-write mechanism, not a content write; nothing landed in objectstack.
- **D6 — screenshots not attached to the PR: ANSWERED, for the seat.** Acceptance #1 on the card asks for zh-CN and en screenshots. The dev's Chromium readings (first-commit text per locale) are in the PR body and the image files are in the dispatch seat's scratch; the REST channel cannot attach images. Not a contract finding; the seat attaches them by a channel that can, or records the readings as the evidence, before closing item 1.
- **D7 — the 34-file boot-path batch ran on content byte-identical to the head before the commit: ANSWERED by the head's check-runs.** All eight `Test` shards, `Test` (aggregate), `Test (dist pins)`, `Type Check`, `Lint` and `Build & E2E` are `success` on `0366b47`; the dev's local readings are the dev's, the gate verdicts are these.

Out-of-scope findings (carrier: none), each noted and left where the dev left it unless said otherwise:

- **O1 — `apps/console/index.html` comment "owns the init screen's ten-language step copy":** stale on the word "step"; file correctly untouched (markup only). A docs nit for a later item on this card.
